# tenarium_tenant_webhook (Resource)

An outgoing webhook of a tenant. Tenarium signs deliveries with the webhook secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant_webhook" "events" {
  tenant_id   = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  url         = "https://hooks.acme.example/tenarium"
  description = "Membership and tenant changes"
  types       = ["tenant.*", "tenant.member_*"]
}

# Hand the signing secret to the receiving service.
output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = tenarium_tenant_webhook.events.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint receiving the events.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered. Defaults to `true`.
- `types` (List of String) Event type patterns such as `tenant.*`. Empty means all events.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret. The API returns it only when the webhook is created, so it is empty after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_tenant_webhook.events <tenant_id>/<webhook_id>
```
